lines: [SYSTEM] 🔴 LIVE! THE MOOT! The fire's built HIGH and the whole GALAXY is watching!
[SYSTEM] TONIGHT: YOU stands accused — THEFT — TAKING WHAT WASN'T THEIRS! The gamblers are FRENZIED! Place your bets, place your bets!
Gus calls the moot. The fire gets built up — word travels fast, and almost everyone comes.
The room is wrong today. Edgy, listening for the wrong things. Evidence feels thin in here.
[SYSTEM] 🔴 LIVE — THE VERDICT IS IN! The galaxy holds its breath!
The fire is built high. Nobody speaks while the count is taken — you can hear the wind past the edge of the light.
Gus counts on their fingers, twice, like they don't trust the first number. Then, to the fire: "10 for guilty. 0 against."
A pause long enough to live in. Someone's breath catches. Then: "Guilty." Nobody looks at anybody.
The sentence is spoken low, like something heavy set down. "You pay. And stay — this time."
Food, work, public apology — You pay it in the open, where everyone can see. The price of staying.
Gus doesn't gloat. Nobody thanks them out loud. But the nods they get by the fire, later — those are real.

A pause long enough to live in. Someone's breath catches. Then: "Guilty." Nobody looks at anybody.
The oldest among them stands. The fire seems to lean in. "You — take what you can carry and go."
◈ CRISIS — THE SCHISM. You are cast out. The village chose, and the choosing cut something that won’t heal clean. The fire keeps burning without you.
SYSTEM: "Social unit ejected. The audience is divided. Half of them are furious. The other half is also furious, but differently."
Exiled. You leave with what you carry — nothing more. Behind you, Haven keeps its fire. Ahead: the world, which just got much bigger.
Be off Haven’s ground by dawn. Still here when the sun’s up, and they won’t ask twice — they’ll come.
📓 Codex: Exiled (moot). Walking.
Whatever Pavlo asked of you stays at the old fire. You're done running errands for people who walked you out.
The pantry is closed to you. The book stays behind. To Haven, you are not one of ours anymore. Membership asked nothing — no presence, no check-ins. Exile is the one way to lose it.
Nobody says Gus was right. Nobody has to. The way the fire settles says it.

transcript.text: (Iyasus speaks only 🇪🇹 Amharic. No shared words at all — just eyes, hands, and patience.)
«ሄይ... አማርኛ ትችላለህ? አይ? ...ውይ።» (Hey... can you speak Amharic? No? ...oh. — you're fairly sure)
(They mime walking — pointing at themselves, then at you, then toward the cache spot. The meaning is unmistakable: come with me.)
"Teach me something from the wild."
"This one — Mesquite. Leaf, stem, smell. You won't forget it now."
"Sure."
It's quiet at the cache spot. Iyasus doesn't say much. Sometimes that's the whole point.

«አዎ፣ ልክ እንደዛ ነው።» (Yes, it's exactly like that. — you're fairly sure) They nod back, slowly. "No?"
(watch quietly)
(gesture)
They're smiling as you go. "Come back anytime."
"About this wound — the need hasn't gone anywhere. I'm still asking. Just... be straight with me."
"Teach me something from the wild."
"This one — Saw Palmetto. Leaf, stem, smell. You won't forget it now."
"What’s going on out there?"
"Everyone's choosing sides and pretending they aren't. I hate it."
"About that favor — we never finished."
"It's getting worse, not better. If it festers I'm no good to anyone — can't haul, can't hunt, can't watch. Just clean it out and wrap it tight."
"About what's been happening — we never finished."
"I stay out of it. Mostly. It's getting harder."
"What happened next?"
"Can I trust you? I mean really."
"I hope to earn it."
"That's the right answer. The wrong one would've been 'yes' too fast."
"What happened next?"
"Trust is slow out here. That's fine. Slow things last.  — or so they tell me."
"What happened next?"
"Alright — I should get back to it."
"Tell me more."
"Someone has to say the thing nobody's saying. Probably won't be me."
"...Actually, forget it."
"...Sorry, lost my train of thought."
"About this wound — I still haven't found anyone. Any chance?"
"What’s going on out there?"
"Hm. Never mind — go on."
"What do you think?"
"I go back and forth. Ask me tomorrow, I'll say different."
"About that favor — we never finished."
"...Actually, forget it."
"About what's been happening — we never finished."
"Keep going."
A warmth settles over the conversation — they lean in a little.
"Keep going."
"Are you angry? At whoever did this. At the sky. At anything."
"Furious. Most days."
"Good. Anger's fuel. Just — point it somewhere useful.  Simple as that."
"Keep going."
"Feel it, then use it. That's the whole trick. I'm still learning it myself. Worth considering."
"Keep going."
"Anyway — I should get back to it. Good talking, though."
"Tell me more."
"That's the whole of it. Sorry."
"It's been a while since we left what's been happening hanging. Glad we circled back."
"We never finished talking about that favor — we wandered off it, 4 days back."
"Walk my trap line with me? Extra hands, extra eyes."
"How can I help?"
"I just said — did you miss it?"
"Teach me something from the wild."
"That's everything I brought back. The rest is just walking."
"Sure."
Marcus shows you where they go to think. "Don't tell the others. Everyone needs one place."

"I just told you — what else is on your mind?"
"About what's been happening — we never finished."
"Yeah... where were we with that."
"Go on."
"Okay. We'll pick this up later."
"Yeah."
"Anyway." A small smile.
"This was good." They mean it.
"About the food I needed — the need hasn't gone anywhere. I'm still asking. Just my read."
"Come get air with me. I need to think out loud."
"Sure."

"I talk to both sides. It hasn't exploded yet."

It's been days since a real meal. I need food before I can't work at all.
"I'll do it."
"Thank you. I won't forget who fed me when it mattered."
"Wait — what were we talking about?"
"I just told you — what else is on your mind?"
"Good question. What do YOU think?"
"What's the worst thing you've done since the sky changed?"
"Yes. I don't want to get into what. But yes."
No judgment in their face. "We're all doing math that doesn't add up. You're still here. That counts."
"Keep going."
"Wait — what were we talking about?"
"We've covered this one. Ask me something else."
"I'll be alright now. Thanks to you."

"Sure."
